articles.title: Returns policy
articles.text: The return window is 30 days from delivery. Returns require an order number.

articles.title: Shipping policy
articles.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Tracking details are sent by email.

articles.title: Support hours
articles.text: Support hours are Monday through Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.
